facts.snippet: with a rota of women who take it in turns to cook, lay the table and clean up
facts.who: New Ground 的女人们（轮值表上的成员）
facts.did: 按轮值表轮流做集体素食晚餐：做饭、摆桌、收拾，这个传统从最早期的社交活动延续至今

facts.snippet: She also established Tea at Three every Friday
facts.did: 发起每周五的「三点茶」，任何人可随时进来喝茶聊天，有人借此摆出桌游

facts.snippet: Maggs put everyone’s name into a hat and pulled out a few each time, inviting the random selection to come for lunch
facts.did: 把所有人名字放进帽子，每次抽几位请到家里吃午饭，好认识不熟的邻居

facts.snippet: It inspired me to create artwork around these letters and the idea of family and war, and I’ve had a solo exhibition.
facts.did: 以父亲的信件与「家庭与战争」为题创作作品，并办了一场个展

facts.snippet: Rachel has joined the community choir.
facts.did: 加入了当地的社区合唱团

facts.snippet: Aleth organised her seventieth birthday here and invited some of her friends from her old mountaineering club.
facts.did: 在 New Ground 办自己的七十岁生日，请来昔日登山俱乐部的朋友

facts.snippet: When Charlotte had a sixtieth-anniversary school reunion, twenty-five of her old school friends came
facts.did: 办毕业六十周年同学会，把二十五位老同学请到 New Ground 开派对

facts.snippet: she takes a daily walk with her carer or daughter, stopping to check on the progress of the plants
facts.did: 大手术后体力不济、走不出社区，便每天由护工或女儿陪着在花园里慢走看植物
